name: WLAN Monitor
author: uBruckhaus
description: See who is on your Wi-Fi from the bar: every device with a type icon and plain-language status, your own names, alerts when a new device joins, collapsible groups (Apple, Android, TV & audio, smart home), FRITZ!Box mesh details, plus signal, traffic and one-click router pages. Active scans only on networks you trust.

barWidget.description: Devices on your Wi-Fi, router access, signal and traffic
